branches.name: g01-completion-programme
branches.reason: The branch introduced the bounded D8→D13 completion programme. The programme document survives byte-identically on current main; the grammar README has since evolved through the completed programme. The branch is therefore an earlier programme-control stage, not stranded authority.

branches.name: g01-d8-falsification
branches.reason: The D8 controlled-falsification result is preserved byte-identically on current main, together with its evidence figures. Later G01 stages build on the recorded PASS; the branch itself is a historical stage head.

branches.name: g01-d9-holdout
branches.reason: The D9 held-out validation result is byte-identical on current main. Its PASS was consumed by later normative reduction and closeout work; no branch-only semantic residue remains.

branches.name: g01-d10-normative
branches.reason: The D10 descriptive-to-normative reduction is preserved byte-identically on current main. Its temporary D11 block led to the bounded D10-S specificity loop now also preserved on main; the stage branch contains no unresolved value.

branches.name: g01-d10s-specificity
branches.reason: The D10-S specificity recovery programme, frozen candidate register and validation result all survive byte-identically on current main. Their successful result was subsequently incorporated into G01 v0.1; this branch is preserved stage history, not missing content.

branches.name: g01-d11-v01-freeze
branches.reason: The branch froze G01 v0.1 as the D11 release. Current main retains that same canonical file and specification, but has deliberately evolved its reader/current-authority presentation from workflow-state wording ('FROZEN D11 RELEASE') to controlled-specification wording. D12/D13 subsequently validate and close the same baseline. Restoring the stage version would reintroduce workflow history, not recover design authority.

branches.name: g01-d12-reference-house
branches.reason: The D12 Reference House conformance result remains current authority in the same canonical file, with the PASS retained and the presentation later distilled from workflow-stage language into reader/current-authority language. The Reference House README has evolved around it; no semantic residue requires salvage.

branches.name: g01-d13-closeout
branches.reason: The D13 adversarial closeout itself survives byte-identically on current main and records the retained M4 G01 v0.1 baseline. The branch's STATUS/README/maturity edits are historical closeout state subsequently superseded by later programme state.
